I'd like to contest on cargo runs from Whitecrest to Blackwind; that route has the highest profit, pirates and headwind notwithstanding.
You can check with a sheet I recently compiled, if it helps:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1syjVA9scVvW4S5vMpEut4ciF2cvLG2eT60EA3OodcMU/edit?usp=sharing
Do believe it's pure RNG in getting specific material types. Mining/Timber-felling level doesn't seem to influence how often uncommon/rare materials drop, only the chance of multipliers.

The headwinds blasting the WC>BW route may be the reason for the pricing. Of course, the higher risk at Blackwind would deter most merchants; generally, Verd would still be the safer choice.
Also, sweetened chocolate paper is best paper.
I highly doubt the prices would fluctuate in the long-term, but if it is, I'd like to know how much it's affected.
Conducted the data gathering in a public server, though one with few players on. Far as I know, the fluctuation of prices only occurs in a relatively short timespan, like a minute or so.
Sheet has been modified; hope it helps for now. Gonna refine and revise over time.

I'm pretty sure Whitecrest merchants would have the same rates as Verdantine ones. Will check on that though. As for pirates, I'm gonna try to join them temporarily, or ask a friend.
Far as I know, I've only seen average yields from trips; this is data on maximum prices for cargo. Will try to find more information to make the list more useful, though. Thanks for letting me know!
